full_judgment: 7. In making the Rule absolute. the learned Judge of the High Court Division, inter alia, held that the lower appellate Court erred in giving retrospective effect to the provision of section 86 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 1950. briefly, the Act, by holding that the disputed property had vested in the Government by reason of the aforesaid provision as amended by President's Order No. 135 of 1972 inasmuch as the land in dispute had re-appeared prior to the date of coming into force of Part V of the Act wherein section 86 finds place.
